# HelloServer Controller - React Server Components
# This controller demonstrates how to render RSC pages with streaming SSR.
# It's the RSC counterpart to HelloWorldController.
#
# ReactOnRailsPro::Stream provides:
# - stream_view_containing_react_components: Streams the view with RSC support
# - Streaming HTML chunks as components render
# - Automatic hydration on the client
#
# For more information, see:
# https://reactonrails.com/docs/pro/react-server-components/

class HelloServerController < ApplicationController
  layout "react_on_rails_default"

  include ReactOnRailsPro::Stream

  def index
    @hello_server_props = {
      title: "Summer tasting room briefing",
      generatedAt: Time.zone.now.strftime("%B %-d, %Y at %H:%M %Z"),
      highlights: [
        "Oak Reserve has the strongest pre-orders for the weekend pickup window.",
        "Citrus Bloom is the only small-batch release with fewer than 20 cases left.",
        "The patio playlist switches to the sunset set at 7:30 PM."
      ],
      metrics: [
        { label: "Walk-in reservations", value: "18" },
        { label: "Cases ready for pickup", value: "42" },
        { label: "Featured flight", value: "Citrus Bloom" }
      ],
      featuredGuest: {
        name: "Mina Ortega",
        hometown: "Santa Barbara, CA",
        request: "Looking for a bright white and a cellar-worthy red."
      }
    }

    stream_view_containing_react_components(template: "hello_server/index")
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

class TastingRequestsController < ApplicationController
  def new
    @tasting_request = TastingRequest.new
    @recent_requests = TastingRequest.order(created_at: :desc).limit(5)
  end

  def create
    @tasting_request = TastingRequest.new(tasting_request_params)

    if @tasting_request.save
      redirect_to new_tasting_request_path, notice: "Request received for #{@tasting_request.name}."
    else
      @recent_requests = TastingRequest.order(created_at: :desc).limit(5)
      render :new, status: :unprocessable_entity
    end
  end

  private

  def tasting_request_params
    params.expect(tasting_request: [ :name, :email, :occasion_notes ])
  end
end

require "test_helper"

class TastingRequestsTest < ActionDispatch::IntegrationTest
  test "invalid submission re-renders and valid submission persists" do
    get new_tasting_request_url

    assert_response :success
    assert_includes response.body, "New tasting request"

    assert_no_difference("TastingRequest.count") do
      post tasting_requests_url, params: {
        tasting_request: {
          name: "",
          email: "not-an-email",
          occasion_notes: "short"
        }
      }
    end

    assert_response :unprocessable_entity
    assert_includes response.body, "Submission could not be saved."
    assert_includes response.body, "Name can't be blank"
    assert_includes response.body, "Email is invalid"

    assert_difference("TastingRequest.count", 1) do
      post tasting_requests_url, params: {
        tasting_request: {
          name: "Avery Stone",
          email: "avery@example.com",
          occasion_notes: "Please prepare a bright white and a structured red for a birthday visit."
        }
      }
    end

    assert_redirected_to new_tasting_request_url
    follow_redirect!
    assert_response :success
    assert_includes response.body, "Request received for Avery Stone."
    assert_includes response.body, "Please prepare a bright white and a structured red for a birthday visit."
  end
end
